beats: My delivery route crosses long dead zones, and a story cutting off mid-sentence felt broken.
Worse, it kept rambling about places I'd already passed.
Like a radio that cuts dead mid-song instead of fading out.
Now the Android app pre-downloads stories ahead of time, so narration keeps playing with zero signal.
It also matched the car's position to the story's sentences, so a story wrapped cleanly the moment I passed.
A dead zone that used to go silent now plays start to finish across four kilometers.
